context.transcript:
Hi. I'm Amina Haddad. I have an appointment for an
oil change. But I was wondering if you could also look
at my car's brakes. I think the brake pads may need to
be replaced soon.
Our brake specialists have a lot of work today, but
if you don't mind waiting a bit, someone should be able
to look at them in about an hour.
Sure. I actually brought some work with me that I could
do. Do you have a wireless Internet network for
visitors?
We do. The password is posted on the wall by the
coffee machine.
context.transcript_translation:
你好，我是阿米娜·哈达德。我预约了换机油，不过我想问问你们能不能也检查一下我汽车的刹车。我想刹车片可能很快需要更换了。
我们的刹车技师今天工作很多，不过如果你不介意稍等一会儿，大约一小时后应该会有人来检查。
可以。我其实带了一些工作过来，可以趁这段时间处理。你们有供访客使用的无线网络吗？
有。密码贴在咖啡机旁边的墙上。
